direct_choice_measurement.definition: score the unique standalone action digit after the exact stored prompt and common canonical JSON prefix; cast the normalized transformer hidden state and tied output embedding to float32 before the full-vocabulary projection and apply Gemma final soft-cap in float32
direct_choice_measurement.tokenizer_preflight: all 150 training and 57 development rows must have a byte-identical prompt/completion seam, one standalone digit token per legal choice, the expected common prefix, and the expected common suffix
direct_choice_measurement.tie_break: report exact ties as a set; deterministic top-1 uses the lowest action index
direct_choice_measurement.greedy_json: enabled on unpermuted rows only with max_tokens 32
direct_choice_measurement.cyclic_scope: all nonzero cyclic rotations of the 57 development rows, semantically mapped back to the original action identities

loss_decomposition.definition: teacher-force each exact scheduled completion at the fixed step-1500 checkpoint and report cross-entropy separately for the eight required JSON-format tokens and one action-choice token
loss_decomposition.duplicate_cache: cache only exact raw input tuples; control requires 150 unique forwards and augmented requires 730 unique forwards while retaining all 3000 scheduled-row summaries
loss_decomposition.normalization: mean per token within each category, plus token-count-weighted overall loss

decision_rules.measurement_artifact_if: direct action-digit results remove the apparent failure: both checkpoints reach at least 32/57 unpermuted development choices and the augmented checkpoint reaches semantic top-1 invariance at least 0.75 with mean probability total variation at most 0.20
decision_rules.direct_choice_failure_confirmed_if: either checkpoint remains below 32/57 direct unpermuted development choices, or either remains cyclic-sensitive by semantic top-1 invariance below 0.75 or mean probability total variation above 0.20
decision_rules.format_dominated_objective_confirmed_if: direct-choice failure is confirmed and, in both arms, mean action-token loss exceeds mean format-token loss; the fixed objective already assigns eight unit-weight format tokens for every one unit-weight action token
decision_rules.if_measurement_artifact: revise the primary static evaluator and rescore retained checkpoints before any new training
decision_rules.if_direct_failure_and_format_dominated: finish only COMP-015's fixed step-1500 paired replications, then preregister an equal-total-mass action-upweighting treatment that retains the JSON scaffold
decision_rules.if_direct_failure_but_not_format_dominat: finish only COMP-015's fixed step-1500 paired replications; treat positional representation, data coverage, or model capacity as more likely than a simple loss-weight imbalance
decision_rules.if_mixed_or_ambiguous: report the ambiguity without changing thresholds after inspection; the harder tiny32 matched action-upweighting gate may still be used as a prospective causal test, but its interpretation must not claim that loss decomposition established the mechanism

compute: local Apple Silicon/Metal only; sequential checkpoint loads; no RunPod
